description: This file defines the StateStorageBridge class, a generic implementation for managing grain state storage in Orleans. It includes methods for reading, writing, and clearing state, as well as handling dehydration and rehydration of state objects. It also defines internal classes for shared storage instances.

classes.name: StateStorageBridge`1
classes.description: Provides functionality for operating on grain state, including reading, writing, clearing, and handling dehydration/rehydration.

classes.name: StateStorageBridgeSharedMap
classes.description: Manages shared instances of state storage bridges to ensure reuse and singleton behavior per storage and state type.

classes.name: StateStorageBridgeShared`1
classes.description: Holds shared references and configuration for a specific state storage bridge.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads the grain state from external storage.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously writes the current grain state to external storage.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously clears the grain state in external storage.

methods.name: OnDehydrate
methods.description: Handles dehydration of the grain state by adding it to the dehydration context.

methods.name: OnRehydrate
methods.description: Handles rehydration of the grain state from the rehydration context.
